facts.fact: Antonio 六岁，Flesh 里母亲只在必须时才亲他，Dream 里他属于一个部落
facts.anchor: Antonio is six years old and his mother kisses him only when she has to

facts.fact: Dream 里孩子们已改用钢剑对练，Mateo 防强攻弱，被 Antonio 扫倒
facts.anchor: the time of wood is over

facts.fact: 斥候看见海盗大帆船起锚复航，梦界的战争将至，Antonio 觉得好玩
facts.anchor: Soon it will be time for the gnashing of teeth

facts.fact: Wendy 梦见自己裸体在海上飞行，头戴礼帽，帽里是否有兔子成了她自己的悬念
facts.anchor: Now the Wondrous Wendy dreams of being naked, with a top hat on her head (will it contain a rabbit?)

facts.fact: 深夜电话把 Wendy 从 Dream 拽回 Flesh，她第一反应是父亲出事
facts.anchor: The phone never brings good news at this time

facts.fact: Wendy 靠职业本能读出 Giada 的情绪是恐惧，被叫去 Giada 家
facts.anchor: What Giada was feeling was fear

facts.fact: 78 岁萨克斯手 Tito 的俱乐部不足一周就关门，他只剩四次拉卷帘门
facts.anchor: Tito will get to shut up the club just four more times

facts.fact: 一月底的寒夜里一个不穿鞋的少女在门口搭话，是她今晚五个观众之一
facts.anchor: She’s a strange one, going around with no shoes on, despite the cold of late January

facts.fact: 少女替一个「办活动」的人邀约 Tito，说正计划最大的一场
facts.anchor: He organises events, and he’s planning the biggest of all

facts.fact: Wendy 骑助力车赶到 Giada 家；自 Giada 给她看过收藏，罗马处处像藏着东西
facts.anchor: Since Giada showed her the collection, Rome hasn’t seemed the same

facts.fact: Giada 说自己在垃圾里找到收藏的「决定性一件」，即那尊断像的原件
facts.anchor: I found the definitive piece of my collection

facts.fact: 那东西藏在 Giada 家浴缸里，Wendy 探头去看
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy stretches her neck to peer over the enamelled edge at the thing

facts.fact: 浴缸里是个非人非兽的男胎：额上两角、褐色长爪、软骨眼睑、耳到口的多齿裂吻、山羊腿与蹄，约三十厘米
facts.anchor: On the crest of the forehead sprout two bony, sharp protuberances, little horns pointed like skewers

facts.fact: Wendy 用魔术师的方法闭眼再看，确认它不是道具：Wonder 至此现出怪诞面目
facts.anchor: The foetus is made of real flesh, it has real bones, and it seems fake only because it’s too real

facts.fact: Giada 说它有角和六英寸的阴茎，话音刚落胎儿睁开眼睛
facts.anchor: The foetus opens its eyes

facts.fact: Michele 喷嚏连天半夜起身找药，父亲 Stefano 坐在客厅扶手椅上凝视虚空，睡眠节律被病颠倒
facts.anchor: Michele gets up. He takes a paracetamol from the bathroom cabinet

facts.fact: Michele 在旧衣柜领带架后打开父亲藏的房间，三平米暗室充满雨后树林般的浓烈气味
facts.anchor: The Secret opens

facts.fact: 失踪的父亲在暗室最里面，把封面画着一整圆加左右两段弧线的黑色小笔记本递给 Michele，赤脚沾着新泥
facts.anchor: Papa’s clasping a little book in his hands, clasping it to his chest like a newborn baby

facts.fact: 胎儿爬出浴缸，Giada 用发胶喷它被躲开；它伸臂只够到 Angela 裸露的肚子，冰凉的爪从肚脐摸到胯再摸回
facts.anchor: The demon is faster. It dodges to the side, avoiding the spray

facts.fact: 反被锁进浴室：孩子在外、大人在内；两人跟踪到厨房的咀嚼声，Wendy 赶走恐惧开灯，本章在此结束
facts.anchor: The Wondrous Wendy casts out fear
